title.en: Public Sector Banks vs Private Sector Banks
title.hi: Public Sector Banks vs Private Sector Banks

rows.en: Majority stake held by Government of India
rows.hi: Majority stake held by Government of India

rows.en: Majority stake held by private shareholders
rows.hi: Majority stake held by private shareholders

rows.en: Driven by board of directors and market forces
rows.hi: Driven by board of directors and market forces

rows.en: Both are regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) under the Banking Regulation Act, 1949.
rows.hi: Both are regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) under the Banking Regulation Act, 1949.

rows.en: Both perform essential banking services like accepting deposits and granting loans.
rows.hi: Both perform essential banking services like accepting deposits and granting loans.

clarification.en: Public Sector Banks are commercial banks where the government holds >50% stake, whereas Public Financial Institutions are entities established by special statutes for specific developmental financing.
clarification.hi: Public Sector Banks are commercial banks where the government holds >50% stake, whereas Public Financial Institutions are entities established by special statutes for specific developmental financing.

relationship.en: PSBs act as the primary vehicle for government-led financial inclusion schemes like PMJDY.
relationship.hi: PSBs act as the primary vehicle for government-led financial inclusion schemes like PMJDY.
